annotation.bound_parties_text: The Regulation amends the AI Act and imposes obligations on providers and deployers of AI systems, notified bodies, Member States and the Commission.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 should be amended to require providers and deployers to take measures to support the development of AI literacy of their staff
annotation.robot_provision_quote: amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689, (EU) 2018/1139 and (EU) 2023/1230 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI)
